query:
insert or ignore into ResolvedTestCaseStates (
                collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date,
                test_case_name,
                state
            )
            select
                collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date,
                test_case_name,
                state
            from TestCaseOverrides
            where collect_nr = $1

            union all

            select
                t.collect_nr,
                t.product_id,
                t.test_run_name,
                t.test_run_date,
                t.name as test_case_name,
                t.state
            from TestCases t
            where
            t.collect_nr = $1
            and not exists (
                select
                    o.collect_nr,
                    o.product_id,
                    o.test_run_name,
                    o.test_run_date,
                    o.test_case_name
                from TestCaseOverrides o
                where t.collect_nr = o.collect_nr
                and t.product_id = o.product_id
                and t.test_run_name = o.test_run_name
                and t.test_run_date = o.test_run_date
                and t.name = o.test_case_name
            )
